# PR1786 (chafreaky / Chafik Boukhalfa), fine source-prime padding

`FINE-PRIME-PADDING.md` and `outer/check_fine_padding.py` (copied; only the first docstring line of the script is relabelled) are from CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds PR1786, branch chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds `research/fine-prime-padding`, head `c52345caa318fc6b1b6e2659c57d746317a72823` (Apache-2.0, as stated in the PR). The mechanism (source primes at relative gap Theta(p^-2) from dyadic targets via Tim Trudgian's effective prime number theorem, arXiv:1401.2689v2 theorem 2; setup precision Cp + 64 p^2 ceil(log2 p); theta-dependent conditioning; polynomial halo p^48 and core p^128; dyadic normalizers; explicit Strassen boundary) is entirely theirs. This package changes only the explicit parameter point (epsilon, beta) and the surrounding stack, see `outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md`.
